input.quote: Section 3.8 Servicer's Fees. As compensation for performing its obligations under this Agreement, the Servicer will be paid the Servicing Fee. On each Payment Date, the Issuer will pay the Servicing Fee to the Servicer according to Section 8.2 of the Indenture. In addition, the Servicer may retain any Supplemental Servicing Fees.
input.rationale: We searched the agreement, appendices and exhibits for MFN-style language ("most favoured/favored nation", "no less favorable", "favorab", "favor", comparable/third-party terms, right-to-match) and found none: every hit on "favor" is a security-interest grant in favour of the Issuer or Indenture Trustee. Servicer compensation in Section 3.8 is a fixed, defined Servicing Fee (plus Supplemental and Temporarily Excluded Receivables Servicing Fees) with no obligation on the Issuer, Depositor or the trust estate to extend Cellco terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and no obligation to match or beat any third-party offer. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation burdening us), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
